name: PostStack
notes: Full stack = 6 full-screen passes (prefilter 1/2, down 1/4, down 1/8, up +=1/4, up +=1/2, composite full res); clean = 1 pass. Scene target HalfFloat MSAA 4x (fallback sRGB UnsignedByte, samples clamped to what the format supports). drawCalls = passes, excluding the scene render. Speed streaks (streaks.ts) are evaluated inside the composite pass. Deterministic: grain/streaks use PostFrame.time only.
